meta.name: kling-3-0
meta.description: Kling 3.0 video generation on RunComfy. Kling 3.0 (also called Kling V3.0) is Kuaishou Technology's third-generation multi-shot video model with native synchronized audio and consistent character identity across shots. This skill covers all six Kling 3.0 endpoints, spanning three rendering tiers (Standard, Pro, 4K) and two modes (text-to-video, image-to-video). Calls runcomfy run kling/kling-3.0/<tier>/<mode> through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "kling", "kling 3.0", "kling v3", "kling pro", "kling 4k", "kling text to video", "kling image to video", or any explicit ask to generate or animate with Kling 3.0.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能调用 RunComfy 生成 Kling 3.0 视频。支持文字转视频和图片转视频，可选标准、专业、4K 三种画质，最长15秒，可带同步音频。
howto.when: 当你提到“kling”、“kling 3.0”、“kling pro”、“kling 4k”等关键词，或明确要求用 Kling 3.0 生成视频时触发。
howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate Kling 3.0 videos via RunComfy. Supports text-to-video and image-to-video with three quality tiers (Standard, Pro, 4K), up to 15 seconds, with optional synchronized audio.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "kling", "kling 3.0", "kling pro", "kling 4k", or explicitly ask to generate or animate with Kling 3.0.

say_en.text: Use Kling 3.0 Standard, text-to-video: a cat running on grass, 5 seconds, 16:9.
Use Kling 3.0 4K, text-to-video: city night skyline timelapse, 10 seconds, 16:9, with audio.
say_en.note: Generates a 10-second 4K video with ambient sound.
